config.packageManager.description: Package manager used to run the Angular CLI. `auto` checks the `packageManager` field in `package.json`, then lockfiles (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `package-lock.json`), and falls back to npm.
config.options.description: Extra arguments per schematic, for example `{ "component": ["--style=scss", "--skip-tests"] }`. Arguments may only contain letters, digits and `- _ . / @ : , =`.
config.openGeneratedFile.description: Open the main generated file after `ng generate` finishes.
config.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the active package manager in the status bar for Angular workspaces.
